item.title: Raised area for pedestrians to cross is a hazard to drivers, 18th October
item.description:
On Hewlett Road, just before Berkamstead school in Cheltenham. There is a piece of pavement that juts into the road and makes an easier place for pedestrians to cross. Last winter I drove over it when it was dark and the piece was obscured by mud and leaves. My tyre burst. The same happened to another driver. After we reported it, a temporary warning sign was put up, but it is still there and no change has been made to the road layout or anything permanent to alert drivers to the pavement coming into the road. It remains a hazard as it is. It needs to be better lit and signed. As we enter dark nights, storms and fallen leaves season, I can't believe it is no better than when it caused problems last winter. Please can you do something about it?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 4, Cleeve View Road, Lynworth, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
